title: Behavioral counseling for healthy weight gain in pregnancy

source.quote: The USPSTF recommends that clinicians offer pregnant persons effective behavioral counseling interventions aimed at promoting healthy weight gain and preventing excess gestational weight gain in pregnancy.

action: Offer pregnant persons effective behavioral counseling interventions aimed at promoting healthy weight gain and preventing excess gestational weight gain.

denominator.note: Pregnancy status during the measurement year; the text gives no age bounds.

numerator.quote: behavioral counseling interventions aimed at promoting healthy weight gain and preventing excess gestational weight gain in pregnancy

derived.window: The text gives no timing; counseling is assumed to be due within the measurement year in which the person is pregnant. Ideally it would fall within the pregnancy episode.
